extractedItems.ruleName: Out of bounds and provisional ball
extractedItems.group: Out of bounds and provisional ball
extractedItems.title: When is a ball out of bounds?
extractedItems.question: Which of these situations means your ball is out of bounds?

choices.text: The entire ball is outside the line formed by the out of bounds posts.
Part of the ball is still on the course side of the out of bounds posts.
The ball is touching an out of bounds post but not fully beyond the line.

extractedItems.explanation: A ball is only out of bounds if the entire ball is outside the line formed by the out of bounds (white) posts.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage girl golfer stands behind a white post on the edge of a golf course fairway, checking if her ball, which is just beyond the post, is fully out of bounds.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen girl golfer checking if her ball is out of bounds beyond a white post on the fairway.

extractedItems.ruleName: Out of bounds and provisional ball
extractedItems.group: Out of bounds and provisional ball
extractedItems.title: What do you do if your ball is out of bounds?
extractedItems.question: If your ball is found to be out of bounds, what must you do next?

choices.text: Drop a ball where it went out of bounds and play on.
Return to where you played your last shot, play again, and take a 1-stroke penalty.
Move the ball back in bounds and keep playing with no penalty.

extractedItems.explanation: You must return to where you last played, play another ball, and add a 1-stroke penalty if your original ball is out of bounds.
extractedItems.imagePrompt: A teenage boy golfer walks back towards the teeing area after discovering his ball is out of bounds just beyond some white posts.
extractedItems.imageAlt: Teen boy golfer heading back to replay his shot because his ball is out of bounds past white posts.

extractedItems.title: Provisional ball becomes the ball in play
extractedItems.question: You play a provisional ball after hitting your first shot toward out of bounds. If your first ball is definitely out of bounds, what happens to your provisional ball?

choices.text: The provisional ball becomes the ball in play with a 1-stroke penalty.
You must pick up the provisional ball and drop another ball at the out of bounds spot.
You continue playing your original ball with no penalty.

extractedItems.explanation: If your first ball is out of bounds, your provisional ball becomes the ball in play with a 1-stroke penalty added.

reviewedItems.group: Out of bounds and provisional ball
reviewedItems.title: When is a ball out of bounds?
reviewedItems.question: Which of these situations means your ball is out of bounds?

choices.text: The entire ball is over the line made by the out of bounds posts.
Part of the ball is still on the course side of the line marked by the out of bounds posts.
The ball is touching an out of bounds post but most of it is still on the course side.

reviewedItems.explanation: A ball is only out of bounds if its entire location is over the line defined by the out of bounds (white) posts. If any part of the ball is in bounds, it is not out of bounds.
